entities.summary: Baron Paul Kray of Krajova and Topolya, was a soldier and general in Habsburg service during the Seven Years' War, the War of Bavarian Succession, the Austro-Turkish War (1788–1791), and the French Revolutionary Wars. He was born in Késmárk, Upper Hungary.
